City approves the harbour rebuild

The council voted on Tuesday to rebuild the eastern harbour wall after four years of argument about who should pay for it.

Construction is expected to begin in the autumn. The wall has been patched eleven times since it was first damaged.

Local fishing crews welcomed the decision but warned that the work will close two of the three loading berths for a full season.
